retrieval.method: Anonymous public website retrieval through Firecrawl; maxAge 0; no authenticated profile or application credential.
retrieval.publicRosterParity: All 298 employer/title/posting-URL triples from the anonymous HTML job roster matched the complete Markdown roster, including multiplicity.
retrieval.hashBasis: Saved UTF-8 Firecrawl capture files, not raw HTTP wire bytes.

publicationRequest: Prepared at the operator request for a sanitized snapshot of Triangle Startups public jobs for community issue #8.
selection: Only employer, title, public posting/detail URLs, public startup/support classification, source dates and synthetic record ID. No descriptions, private notes, contacts, applicant/candidate records, internal database IDs, account data or credentials.
recordIds: Synthetic row IDs derived from employer, title and posting URL. These are not database IDs or a claim that job identity should be matched by title.
availability: unknown for every row; capture establishes public roster membership, not a new employer check.
scopeBasis: The public page classified 297 startup roles and one startup-support role. Its support role is NC IDEA. No new company classification was inferred.

validation.sourceLinkAudit: All 298 source links match the public Markdown roster, use HTTP(S), contain no URL credentials or email addresses, and contain no access-token, API-key, session, authorization or signature query keys.
